_howToEdit: The photo in the "Why choose R&M" section. image is the photo path: upload the photo to public_html/images/ in cPanel first. Use an upright (portrait) photo, about 800 x 900 pixels and under 300 KB. The logo sits over the photo's top-right corner, so pick a shot with sky or trees there and the roof lower down. alt describes the photo for blind visitors and Google. The earlier stock photo is kept in public_html/images/legacy/: to go back to it, copy the image and alt from _previous into photo. Save the file and reload the website; no rebuild is needed. If the old photo comes back on its own, a comma or quote is out of place: paste the file into jsonlint.com to find it.
